blocks.text: A small request concerning the conference room. Twice last week the room was held informally by one of us while someone else had already entered the same hour on the shared calendar, and on both occasions a meeting began late as a result. From now on I would ask that we treat the calendar as the only record of who has the room, and that a booking be entered there before the time is offered to anyone outside the firm.
If you hold a standing meeting that is not yet on the calendar, please add it before the end of this week so that the record is complete.
